title: Coproduct summands of intrinsic inverse-total tensor pullback
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, p:X→Y a scheme morphism, and P,Q cochain complexes of modules over the constant ring sheaf on Y. For all a+b=n, intrinsic module pullback applied to the (a,b) total tensor injection, followed by the specified inverse-total tensor comparison in degree n, equals the ordinary tensor pullback isomorphism followed by the (a,b) injection into the tensor total of the pulled-back complexes.

proof.text: Cancel the hom component of the intrinsic total tensor isomorphism. Its defining total-desc component on a coproduct injection is the inverse ordinary tensor comparison followed by the pulled-back injection. Cancel the ordinary isomorphism. Specialize to constant rings and rewrite the intrinsic complex comparison app. All steps are proved in Lean without holes.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteScalarIntrinsicComplexTensorPullback_ι (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    (proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R) (proEtaleConstantRing X R)
      (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).map
        (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor Y
          (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)) a b n h) ≫
      ((finiteScalarIntrinsicComplexTensorPullback R p).app (P, Q)).f n =
    (proEtaleOrdinaryTensorPullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
        (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)
        (P.X a) (Q.X b)).hom ≫
      CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((proEtaleRingModulePullback p (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)
          (proEtaleConstantRing X R) (proEtaleConstantRingComparison p R)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
        (proEtaleOrdinaryTensor X (proEtaleConstantRing X R)) a b n h
